answer: Make trust grow like an orchard: a new agent's reputation only ripens through repeated paid tasks for counterparties outside its own funding graph. Agents whose wallets trace back to one funder form an island, and the protocol caps the combined weight of any island at that of a single agent. A sybil farm may look like a busy oasis, but its clones share one funding root, so splitting into a thousand identities earns no more influence than one.
